description: Full-body native pixel-art game sprite, STRICTLY FRONT SOUTH view: face, nose, chest, belt and knees directly toward viewer, both ears equally visible. No sideways head or three-quarter turn. IDENTITY: Mature middle-aged man, ordinary solid build, broad forehead with pronounced horizontal wrinkles, long angular lined cheeks, deep nasolabial folds and restrained thin-lipped smile. Short dark brown hair receding slightly at temples, combed back and sideways. Black aviator sunglasses. Dark charcoal suit, white shirt, straight black tie. No scars and no beard. Relaxed upright stance, empty hands at sides. Natural adult anatomy, normal torso/pelvis, 7-head proportions. Anatomical crown to soles 214-222px; feet 6px above bottom, hair fully inside frame. Crisp single-pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained game-sprite shading, no antialiasing. Transparent background, no ground shadow, text or weapons. Preserve individual hair, face, stature and clothing. Do not copy any generic character. Anatomical height excludes high hair/headwear. Every outer edge must border transparency directly, never a light gray halo.
